cards.title: Your 2b notes, in
cards.text: Reviving, zoom, glowing doors, longer coins and the rogue's dash. Live now as 0.5.0.
cards.why: The clip is one room at double speed, through to the doors this time. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Twenty full test runs, about 600 rooms, none stuck.

The boulders, traps and chest are being redrawn by an artist in this art round; they're still the old look in the clip.

parts.title: Revive
parts.text: A downed hero is revived by an ally standing over them for 3 seconds, at 10% HP. The nearest ally who isn't fighting goes over; enemies nearby keep them away. Support heroes reviving better comes with those heroes.

parts.title: Zoom
parts.text: The camera starts further out. Pinch to zoom in or out (mouse wheel on a computer); it remembers your zoom.

parts.title: Doors
parts.text: Each door's opening glows in the colour of the room behind it; the one the party takes glows brightest. At most 3 doors per room now, so they never crowd.

parts.title: Rogue dash
parts.text: The rogue dashes: away when an enemy is on it as it backs off, or in at a target that's 2 to 5 body-lengths off. It also goes after enemies on their own, even far away, more than before.

parts.title: Archer stuck
parts.text: Heroes now ease in as they reach a spot instead of overshooting it and swinging back, which is what looked like jitter. In testing the archer never ended up inside a wall. Tell me if you still see it stuck, and where.
